# UCG brand kit

> Brand guidelines and assets for United Club Gymnastics (UCG), a volunteer-run nonprofit for adult club gymnastics. Read BRAND.md first, then the reference for your medium.

- [BRAND.md](https://united-club-gymnastics.github.io/ucg-brand/BRAND.md): core rules (palette, AA contrast, fonts, logos, voice, checklist)
- [Color pairs](https://united-club-gymnastics.github.io/ucg-brand/references/color-pairs.md)
- [Email](https://united-club-gymnastics.github.io/ucg-brand/references/email.md)
- [Web and tools](https://united-club-gymnastics.github.io/ucg-brand/references/web.md)
- [Google Slides](https://united-club-gymnastics.github.io/ucg-brand/references/slides.md)
- [Google Docs and Forms](https://united-club-gymnastics.github.io/ucg-brand/references/docs.md)
- [Google Sheets](https://united-club-gymnastics.github.io/ucg-brand/references/sheets.md)
- [Social and print](https://united-club-gymnastics.github.io/ucg-brand/references/social.md)
- [Video and Reels](https://united-club-gymnastics.github.io/ucg-brand/references/video.md)
- [Messaging](https://united-club-gymnastics.github.io/ucg-brand/references/messaging.md)
- [Assets](https://united-club-gymnastics.github.io/ucg-brand/references/assets.md)
- [brand.json](https://united-club-gymnastics.github.io/ucg-brand/brand.json)
- [CSS tokens](https://united-club-gymnastics.github.io/ucg-brand/tokens/ucg.css)
